problem_text:
A logistics manager is tasked with assembling a fleet of cargo containers to be loaded onto a freight transport vessel, aiming to maximize the total utility score of the shipments while adhering to the vessel's total tonnage limit.

The available container types are:
* Container A: weight 20 tons, utility 121 points
* Container B: weight 3 tons, utility 295 points
* Container C: weight 28 tons, utility 219 points
* Container D: weight 35 tons, utility 183 points
* Container E: weight 14 tons, utility 76 points
* Container F: weight 19 tons, utility 54 points
* Container G: weight 9 tons, utility 40 points
* Container H: weight 22 tons, utility 35 points
* Container I: weight 9 tons, utility 44 points
* Container J: weight 34 tons, utility 66 points
* Container K: weight 8 tons, utility 34 points
* Container L: weight 8 tons, utility 85 points
* Container M: weight 25 tons, utility 166 points
* Container N: weight 2 tons, utility 235 points
* Container O: weight 7 tons, utility 107 points
* Container P: weight 39 tons, utility 270 points
* Container Q: weight 36 tons, utility 16 points
* Container R: weight 15 tons, utility 94 points
* Container S: weight 1 ton, utility 234 points
* Container T: weight 17 tons, utility 158 points
* Container U: weight 39 tons, utility 102 points
* Container V: weight 33 tons, utility 211 points
* Container W: weight 21 tons, utility 63 points
* Container X: weight 11 tons, utility 71 points
* Container Y: weight 36 tons, utility 84 points
* Container Z: weight 31 tons, utility 89 points
* Container AA: weight 1 ton, utility 27 points
* Container AB: weight 20 tons, utility 121 points

Furthermore, due to incompatible handling requirements, exactly one of Container A and Container B must be included in the shipment.

A special handling protocol is required if Container C is selected; this protocol consumes an additional 10 tons of the vessel's effective loading capacity.
The vessel's maximum gross loading capacity is 380 tons. The manager must determine the optimal selection of containers.
